Timing chain - removing and installing
Assembly overview - timing chain
1 - Chain tensioner
Always replace chain tensioner after removing.
Observe the notes on the oil supply before installing.
2 - Timing chain
Mark the running direction before removing.
Replace if damaged or worn.
3 - Camshaft adjuster
Self-locking bolts must always be replaced.
4 - Gasket
Gasket - replace after removing
5 - Sprocket
The sprockets should be replaced together with the chain.
Chain guide must be replaced when the chain is stretched.
Check the guide rails for wear.
Do not reuse sealing ring.
6 - Notes
Replace the engine oil and the oil filter after the repair.
Replace.
